Microsoft.549981C3F5F10.Note: The voice assistant. Retired as an app by Microsoft; Start menu search does not need it.

Microsoft.Copilot.Note: The Copilot app. Reinstallable from the Store if you want it back.

Microsoft.BingNews.Note: News feed app. Pairs with the news and interests tweak in TWEAKS.

Microsoft.BingWeather.Note: Also the source of the taskbar weather widget's data.

MicrosoftWindows.Client.WebExperience.Note: Windows 11 only, and it hosts the Widgets board and its background process. Not recommended here because the Widgets tweak in TWEAKS already stops it running and can be undone; this removes it. Reinstallable from the Store as Windows Web Experience Pack.

Microsoft.BingSearch.Note: The web results component of Start search. Local file and app search is unaffected.

Microsoft.MicrosoftOfficeHub.Note: The 'Get Office' promotion tile. Not Office itself: a real Office install is untouched.

Microsoft.GetHelp.Note: Support chat app. Some Settings troubleshooter links stop working.

Microsoft.WindowsFeedbackHub.Note: Only needed if you file Windows Insider feedback.

Microsoft.Windows.DevHome.Note: Developer dashboard shipped with Windows 11. Nothing depends on it.

Microsoft.MixedReality.Portal.Note: Windows Mixed Reality was discontinued in 2024. Dead weight unless you own a WMR headset.

Microsoft.Microsoft3DViewer.Note: 3D model viewer. Removed from new Windows installs anyway.

Microsoft.Print3D.Note: 3D printing app. Removed from new Windows installs anyway.

Microsoft.SkypeApp.Note: Consumer Skype was retired in May 2025.

Microsoft.YourPhone.Note: Links an Android or iPhone to the PC. Remove only if you do not use it: it runs a background service.

MicrosoftWindows.CrossDevice.Note: The newer half of Phone Link, including phone-as-webcam. Remove together with Phone Link or not at all.

Microsoft.People.Note: Contacts app used by the retired Mail client.

microsoft.windowscommunicationsapps.Note: The classic Mail and Calendar apps, retired at the end of 2024 in favour of the new Outlook. Remove only if you do not read mail here.

Microsoft.OutlookForWindows.Note: The web-based Outlook that replaced Mail. Remove only if you do not read mail here.

Microsoft.ZuneMusic.Note: The default music and media player. Removing it leaves audio files with no default app until you set one.

Microsoft.ZuneVideo.Note: The default video player and the Microsoft video store.

Microsoft.WindowsMaps.Note: Offline maps app. Its updater task is one of the ones the Telemetry tweak disables.

Microsoft.XboxApp.Note: The deprecated Windows 10 Xbox app, replaced by the Xbox / Game Pass app. Safe: nothing signs in through it any more.

Microsoft.XboxGamingOverlay.Note: Win+G overlay, the built-in FPS counter and Win+Alt+R capture. Removing it also removes the per-game Game Mode toggle UI. Keep it if you use any of that.

Microsoft.XboxGameOverlay.Note: The companion package to Game Bar. Remove together with Game Bar or not at all.

Microsoft.Xbox.TCUI.Note: Draws the Xbox account, friends and achievement panels inside games. Some Game Pass and Microsoft-published titles fail to open those panels without it. Leave it unless you are sure.
